plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Automated codex review loop on the current branch's PR — request a review, wait for codex, fix the findings, re-request until clean. Drives the chatgpt-codex-connector GitHub App so you don't have to babysit it.

plugins.name: screenshot-pr
plugins.description: Captures before+after screenshots of the visual changes in the current PR (desktop + mobile-web) with Playwright MCP, uploads them to GitHub as user-attachments, and posts/updates a single bot comment. Repo-agnostic via an optional .screenshot-pr.json.

plugins.name: aso-appstore-screenshots
plugins.description: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots — analyzes your app's codebase to discover core benefits, pairs them with simulator screenshots, then builds ASO-optimized images via a deterministic Pillow scaffold enhanced by Nano Banana Pro (Gemini MCP). Adapted from adamlyttleapps/claude-skill-aso-appstore-screenshots.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Chooses which model runs a delegated task — subagent, parallel fan-out, or Workflow stage — by scoring the work on cost, intelligence, and taste, then routing to the cheapest model that clears the bar (gpt-5.5 via the codex plugin; fable-5 / opus-4.8 / sonnet-5 via the Agent/Workflow model param). Model-routing rubric adapted from Theo Browne (@t3dotgg).
